summary: Diff implements frontend VIP status querying via backend (useIsCallerVIP -> actor.isCallerVIP), adds VIP pricing utilities and copy labels, introduces a height options constant and appears to convert the order form to use a Select, and adds a prominent “2–3 week Delivery time” badge on the landing page. It also adds several additional UI/UX features not requested (e.g., VIP congratulations dialog, promo-code UX, order retry/error handling, broader marketing/admin UI adjustments) and introduces an extra backend Motoko module (backend/migration.mo) despite the constraint emphasizing a single actor file.
